## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. For documentation, describe what the reader can now understand or do.

## Scope and context

Link the issue or development phase when applicable. Explain significant decisions and remaining limitations.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results. Include relevant failure cases; for documentation-only changes, describe the consistency and link checks.

## Review

- [ ] The change meets its stated acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] The diff has been reviewed for secrets, generated files, and unrelated changes.
